Correct answer: 1+2i. Neither matches. Check the original: (3+4i)(1-2i) = 3 - 6i + 4i + 8 = 11 - 2i, over 5, giving 11/5 - 2/5 i, consistent with the problem. So the correct answer is 1+2i.
